prior_evidence.v2_notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT, flagging for human review rather than silently resolving: 黄梅 (Huangmei) is, in standard administrative geography, a county in Huanggang, HUBEI province (immediately across the Yangtze from Jiujiang, Jiangxi) — not Jiangxi. The Sinopec table's own '途经省市' cell literally reads '江西黄梅、九江市' with no province name before 黄梅, which is consistent with either (a) the source genuinely treating Huangmei as Jiangxi (matching GEM's existing StartState/Province, which also says Jiangxi), or (b) a column/OCR alignment artifact in my pdftotext -layout extraction of a multi-column table that dropped a leading '湖北' (Hubei) before 黄梅. I could not distinguish these from the extracted text alone and did not want to silently 'correct' either the source or GEM's value. Staging this ref because it does textually support GEM's current Jiangxi/Jiangxi pairing exactly as entered (so it is not a value change), but downgrading tier to low and flagging explicitly: worth a human check of the raw PDF's table layout (not just my text extraction) before treating StartState/Province='Jiangxi' for Huangmei as settled.
